description: This file contains utility functions related to displaying and diagnosing gateway status information in an Android application for OpenClaw. It includes functions for generating version labels, interpreting connection statuses, and constructing diagnostic reports. Also, it provides functionality to copy such reports to the clipboard.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Generates a version label string for the Android app, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and the version name is not already a dev version.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a sanitized display string for a gateway status, defaulting to 'Offline' if input is empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Determines if a gateway status indicates that diagnostics are available, i.e., status is not 'Offline' or 'Connecting'.

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Checks if a gateway status string suggests pairing or approval activity.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Builds a detailed diagnostic report string containing device info, app version, gateway status, and other relevant info for troubleshooting gateway connectivity issues.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the generated diagnostics report to clipboard and shows a confirmation toast.
